resources.string: Space imagery from ESA/Hubble, ESA/Webb, ESO and NOIRLab as your TV screensaver. Images are downloaded straight to this TV and shown from its local cache.
Unable to open screensaver settings automatically. Open them from your TV\'s system settings and select Cosmos.
All image sources are switched off.
No account, analytics, tracking or advertising. Cosmos connects only to the image sources listed here, and everything it downloads stays on this TV.
Watch the slideshow now. Press any button to stop.
Opens the TV\'s screensaver settings. Choose Cosmos there.
How long each image stays on screen.
Checks the sources for new images. This also happens automatically.
Press select again to delete every downloaded image.
Fills the screen without distortion, trimming edges that do not fit.
Shows the entire picture without distortion, with black bars where needed.
Fills the screen when little would be trimmed, otherwise shows the whole picture.
One image pixel per screen pixel, centred. Large images are trimmed.
Fills the screen by stretching the picture. Distorts most images.
Small, translucent title and credit in a corner.
Title, credit, source and licence on a soft backing.
Only images that cover a 4K screen without upscaling.
Prefers 4K images, adding 1080p ones while fewer than 20 4K images are available.
Skips images too small to cover the screen at this resolution.
Uses images of any resolution. Small ones will look soft.
For personal viewing: uses every publicly available image from the enabled sources.
Only images individually verified as CC BY 4.0. Anything unclear is skipped.
No images yet. Open Cosmos to download images.
